facts.fact: NIDA is enrolling people for the Digital ID, with Digital IDs expected in July 2027, and describes technology replacing the physical card as the main means of authentication.

RWA.note: Unrecorded births are named as a barrier to ID enrolment, but no exchange of records between the registers is stated.

facts.fact: NIDA said more than 8 million people had been registered for the Digital ID, about 55% of Rwanda's 14.6 million population (divided by the population held, not stated in the document).

RWA.note: No ID number given at birth is stated.
Nothing stated about who builds or runs the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: NIDA's nationwide Digital ID registration began in October 2025 and had registered more than 8 million people and photographed more than 7 million by mid-August 2026.
NIDA's director general referred to the current physical ID cards, which are to be phased out in June 2027.
